svg.title: Four indexed colors become literal SIXEL paint characters
svg.desc: An eight by six four-color indexed grid is split into four masks. The exact-mask body is #1o{BN#3o{BN$#0NB{o#2NB{o. The size-policy body replaces two mask runs with #1!4~#3!4~ before repairing the blue and green pixels.
svg.text: From four indexed colors to actual SIXEL characters
This 8 × 6 example is one complete band. The strings at right are literal encoder paint bodies.
Each column becomes a six-bit value.
o, {, B, and N are data characters, not labels.
returns to the band's left edge
DCS wrapper and palette definitions omitted.
Both bodies decode to the same four-color pixels; size saves two bytes in this tiny example.
